{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Borg_Construct_AJ6_Side_Schematic.png|thumb|right|250px|Side schematic of the Borg Construct Aj^6 showing the unit's Computer Interface Port.]]
A '''Computer Interface Port''' was a component installed on [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[AJ^6 cyborg construct/Legends|AJ^6 cyborg construct]]. The unit had four such ports on either side of the unit, allowing the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] to access [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and interface directly with them.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
